contexts.text: Certain Spirits... were reduced into such a state that they could be elevated into Heaven, being lulled as to corporeal things and phantasies. AC 542. SE 2109.
So long as man lives in the body... these interior things are as it were lulled...
Certain Souls... who desired to see the glory of the Lord... were lulled as to the exterior senses and lower faculties into a kind of sweet sleep.

This can also be perceived by the unregenerate while the cupidities of these loves are quiescent with them, as takes place when they are in holy meditation, or while they are laid asleep, which takes place when they are in misfortunes, sicknesses, etc... Then, since bodily and worldly things have been laid asleep, and are as it were dead, they perceive something of heavenly light, and of comfort thence. But there is no removal of their cupidities with them, but only a lulling... With the evil bodily and worldly things can also be laid asleep, and then they can be elevated as it were into something heavenly... these external things are then laid asleep with them, and so they are carried into the First Heaven.
The falsity... that a man is saved... if only in the state of lulling of bodily things that is usual for a short time before death he utters something of faith with apparent affection.
When the things of the external man are only lulled; as in misfortunes.
When these loves are lulled, which takes place in a state of disease.
Then the natural memory is lulled, and they are awakened into the interior memory.
Then their interiors are opened, and their exteriors are lulled. HH 499. HH 501, Explained.
The man with whom the spiritual degree is opened comes into this wisdom when he dies; and is also able to come into it by the lulling of the sensations of the body...
a. For confession is a lulling of all things...
When (after death) the External is lulled, and the Internal awakes...
These things... have been seen not in any dozing state of the mind; but in a state of full wakefulness.
Who in the world had lulled the understanding to sleep...
Such an opinion has lulled to sleep many men.
Evil Spirits lulled by singing.
This cannot be restored, but can only be reduced to nothing, so that it is lulled as it were in sleep, or as in death... Therefore it is merely the lulling of it...
At last their bodily delights can be lulled...
That he may be let into his evils, lest they lie dormant...
Otherwise (their sensuous things) would be dormant...
With those who come into the interior Heaven the Natural is lulled.
The Voluntary is then lulled...
While their confirmed falsities are lulled...
In this state the former state is lulled.
The love of evil is then stored away or lulled with them...
There is such a thing as a holy External and a profane Internal: the Internal is lulled... the External is not lulled.
